preservation_policy: Never delete a genuinely different custom design during cleanup.

Automatic removal is limited to exact same art, palette-only recolors, same-silhouette duplicate/pattern edits when they are not a canon form, placeholders/invalid exports, and duplicate source aliases.
If two designs differ materially in silhouette, anatomy, theme, armor, appendages, proportions, or concept, both survive for side-by-side approval.
Same-named concepts with different art are grouped as art options, not silently deleted.
X/Y/Z, regional Mega, Redux Mega, Delta Mega, and other explicitly distinct concepts remain separate.
Custom Mega is preferred over Gigantamax art when both exist; Gigantamax stays reference-only.
Official canon Mega remains source of truth for canon Mega identity.
recovery_note: Resume from these committed checkpoint files. Do not depend on a transient local CSV or /mnt/data mount to recover cleanup state. Any future row-level approval/export table must be committed under sprite-work/ before being treated as authoritative.
